scope: Agent-owned simulations and scenes; preset engines removed from the shipped application

preserved_attempt.reason: Generated code returned additional per-cell samples outside the declared output contract; original failure and raw outputs preserved. The planner/experimenter now receive the complete output schema and a generic measurements field.

visualization_options: Spatial occupation sequence: show actual occupied directed bonds and the largest SCC on a periodic square lattice. This exposes street direction correlations and cluster mergers, but individual realizations cannot establish wrapping probabilities.

Scalar ensemble curves: show horizontal wrapping probability and mean largest-SCC fraction against occupation probability for both ensembles. These directly represent the scientific endpoints but obscure the local connectivity mechanism and require supervisor aggregation across independent replicates.
live_run.scene_title: Directed street occupation: local spatial crop
live_run.scene_scope: Actual lower-left lattice patch, with all occupied bonds whose endpoints lie inside it. The full periodic L=16 graph is analyzed. Connections leaving the crop are omitted; winding cannot be inferred from this crop. Filled vertices belong to the full-graph largest SCC; ties use smallest vertex index. Configurations are nested occupation samples, not physical motion or independent replicates.

summary.interval_method: Paired-seed Student t interval, 95%; exploratory, no sequential or multiple-testing correction.
summary.units: indicator per realization; ensemble mean is probability

limitations: Eight pairs provide limited precision; the interval is exploratory and has no sequential or multiple-testing correction.
The supplied summaries report sanity and replay passes, but raw paired samples, fixture outputs and artifact contents were not independently inspected here.
Wrapping probabilities use all valid independent realizations as their denominator; largest-SCC fractions use L squared, and correlated occupation frames must not inflate sample counts.
Independent fair street signs are an agent-defined ensemble whose equivalence to seed reference 40 remains unverified; literature coverage is incomplete.
One lattice size and one primary occupation probability cannot establish critical thresholds, universality, scientific novelty or real-world validity.
The implementation specifies a local scene crop rather than the planned full-lattice display; its omitted connections prevent visual inference of full-graph winding.
No measured runtime or comparable acceleration baseline was supplied, so an acceleration improvement is unsupported.
No separate measurement_contract was supplied; interpretation follows the implemented horizontal-winding endpoint and reported paired summary.
decision.next_experiment: Run a prospectively budgeted study with more independent seed pairs at L=16 and p=0.70, retaining both ensembles and the 0.25 practical threshold.
decision.rationale: The measured treatment-minus-control difference is 0.125, below the fixed practical threshold of 0.25; its exploratory 95% paired interval [-0.411, 0.661] includes zero and substantial effects in both directions. Each arm contains eight independent realizations; occupation frames are not additional replicates. Sanity and replay passes support the reported empty-graph behavior and repeatability, not independent scientific validation. This result changes the decision from screening for a large effect to prioritizing precision at the same endpoint. No supported treatment-only parameter change can resolve that uncertainty in one remaining round: changing treatment L while retaining the L=16 baseline would confound lattice size with orientation ensemble, and changing occupation_scale would confound occupation with orientation. Source seed, page 5 states: "one can separately find thresholds for horizontal and vertical wrapping." This supports distinguishing directional endpoints, not a predicted ensemble difference.
decision.result_interpretation: Treatment wrapped in 75% of realizations versus 62.5% for control, but the paired interval leaves the effect inconclusive despite passing sanity and replay checks.

scientific_limits: Agent-generated model and scene geometry require independent numerical/domain validation.
The comparison is inconclusive; no full reproduction, novelty, universality or measured acceleration claim.
